note: The sign-in state from the login-status command, which exits 0 when signed in and 1 when not (recorded/FINDINGS.md step 2: login-in.txt is `Logged in using ChatGPT` with exit 0, login-out.txt is `Not logged in` with exit 1). Only the exit code decides the state; a null exit means the program could not run and is unknown. The mode is read from the text, stdout then stderr joined, by fixed case-insensitive substrings only (`chatgpt`, `api key`), and only when signed in; nothing else of the text is kept, not even an e-mail address. Which stream the recorded rows came from is not noted in the recording, so their stdout is kept as recorded. The probe of codex-cli 0.165.0 on 2026-10-29 (an empty signed-out CODEX_HOME, no credentials) found `Not logged in` on STDERR with stdout empty and exit 1. The signed-in line on stderr (the stderr rows with exit 0) is expected from the same CLI but is NOT probed yet: no signed-in run was made. The null-exit rows and the API-key wording are rules, not recordings.
